summary: AI chatbox app with Google Gemini integration, where users provide their own free Gemini API key. Features include chat, image generation, and download. Future plans include Ekadashi reminders, subscription option, community tab, and admin panel.
architectural_notes: AI chatbox uses Google Gemini API; users must provide their own Gemini API key (free tier available)
App features: AI chat, image generation, and download functionality

existing_features.title: Replace the existing OpenRouter-based AI text chat implementation in `frontend/src/lib/aiEngine.ts` with Google Gemini API (model: `gemini-1.5-flash` or `gemini-pro`). The engine should send user messages to the Gemini REST endpoint (`https://generativelanguage.googleapis.com/v1beta/models/gemini-1.5-flash:generateContent`) using the user's stored Gemini API key. Preserve existing message history handling, error handling, and the helper functions for API key storage/retrieval.

Update the API key configuration UI in `frontend/src/pages/AIGuru.tsx` to reference Google Gemini instead of OpenRouter. Change all labels, placeholder text, and help copy to say 'Gemini API Key' and direct users to `https://aistudio.google.com/app/apikey` to obtain a free key. Remove any OpenRouter-specific instructions.

Update `frontend/.env.example` and any relevant comments or documentation strings in the codebase to reflect that the app now uses the Google Gemini API instead of OpenRouter/OpenAI. Note that users obtain a free Gemini API key from Google AI Studio.

new_feature_requests.summary: Switch AI backend from OpenAI to Google Gemini (users provide their own free Gemini API key)
